name: Grok Business
desc: Grok for teams, with enterprise security, shared projects and higher rate limits.
desc_zh: 面向团队的 Grok，带企业安全、共享项目与更高速率上限。
solves: Personal assistants leak company data and cap out on usage; this keeps work data private and raises the limits.
solves_zh: 个人助手会漏公司数据还会撞上限；这个把工作数据保住并抬高限额。
best_for: You want your whole team on Grok without wondering whether yesterday's documents trained someone's model.
best_for_zh: 想让全队用上 Grok，又不想担心昨天的文档喂了别人模型时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory）。 Missing from the ledger. Launched 2025-12-30 together with Grok Enterprise, which is the same platform plus Custom SSO and Directory Sync (SCIM); only Grok Business is recorded here so the two tiers are not double counted. Self-serve for small and medium teams, sales-led for larger organizations. 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/grok-business
